comments.text:
BG3 on release was full of bugs and missing content, Act 3 basically was unplayable, even act 2 had a lot of game breaking bugs, and yet everybody handed out 9/10 and 10/10, and called it a perfect game, while little old me encountered game breaking bugs in act 2 and i didn't touch it for a year before i finished it, and it wasn't just a me problem, everybody had similar issues like me, friends, content creators etc. Yet barely any review site mentioned it. The gamer for example gave it a 10/10, i just read their review on BG3, and didn't even mention nothing on the gamebreaking bugs, that everbody has encountered, the multiple broken quest lines.
Somehow when it comes to crimson desert, without the day 1 patch mind you, the bugs and the broken questlines start to matter.
Please for the love of everything that's dear, don't trust video game journalists with 0 transparency, people should just watch their favorite content creators that they usually agree with and trust, and decide for yourself if it's worth it or not.
